name: SOD Conflicts on Access Request Notification
description: Sent to the identity a request was made for when their access request cannot be forwarded to an approver because of a separation of duties (SoD) conflict.
subject: Your access request was blocked by an SoD conflict
body:
Access request blocked by an SoD conflict

Hello $requesterName,

You recently requested access to #set($sep="")#foreach($item in $accessRequestItems.split(","))$sep$item.trim()#set($sep=", ")#end.

We were unable to forward this access request to an approver because of a separation of duties (SoD) conflict. Your request has been blocked.

Some combinations of access are not allowed under your organization's security policy. An SoD rule is designed to prevent one person from having too much control over a sensitive process.

Request details

  • Requested by: $accessRequestDetails.requestBy
  • Requested for: $accessRequestDetails.requestedFor
  • Date: $accessRequestDetails.date

Return to $__global.productName to view more details.

Review your request

Best regards,
The $__global.productName Team
